messages:
maria_cs: Quick heads-up — CatalyzeAI onboarding is moving into production next week and I’m seeing rising cost/latency vs their SLA. p95 generation latency ~2.3s and per-token cost up ~42% since they started using the larger variant. Thinking we should proactively propose a low-risk perf plan (quant + model swap + routing) before renewal conversations.

ryan_se: Can you share current model names + traffic split and any eval regressions they’ve reported?

maria_cs: Current: redwood/transformer-xl-large-v1 (80%), redwood/transformer-medium-v1 (20%). Customer uses short chat + occasional long summarize jobs. No major quality complaints yet — they said "slower but acceptable" but cost is a sticking point. Internal sims suggest int8 quantization + swapping large -> a q-friendly mid-size reduces cost by ~35% in perf sims, p95 to ~1.1s for chat paths.

maria_cs: Proposed rollout (high level):
```
- Candidate model: redwood/transformer-medium-q8 (quantized int8 variant)
- Routing policy: 70% medium-q8, 25% medium-v1 (non-q), 5% large-v1 as fallback
- Canary: start at 5% for 24h, monitor p95, error rate, token-quality evals
- Acceptance: no >1.5x increase in top-1 edit distance on our prompt set; p95 improvement >=20%
```

oliver_ml: Quick notes — int8 is fine for their mix (short chat + summaries) but watch long-context summarization: KV-cache precision loss can creep in. Recommend running our longform eval harness on the q8 candidate before canary. Also suggest a hybrid quant profile: quantize attention/FFN but keep LayerNorm in fp16 to reduce regressions.

ryan_se: Sounds good. I can spin the canary in Dedicated tomorrow 10:00 PT. I’ll attach the rollout config to the ticket and set the tracing hooks for token-level latency. What KPI thresholds do we want in the ticket?

maria_cs: KPI checklist for the ticket: p95 latency <=1.5s, token cost reduction >=30%, consumer-facing error-rate <=0.1%, and pass the longform eval with <=1.2x edit distance. If any regression, auto-roll back. Also schedule a 30m enablement call with CatalyzeAI to walk through expected behavior and monitoring.

oliver_ml: Add one more: monitor "answer-stability" on 10 golden prompts (we’ll provide) — if stability drops, we pause. I’ll run the eval tonight and post results here.

ryan_se: I created the canary job and the rollout policy in Console (will tag ticket). Canary id: canary-176850-CA. deploy-bot: Canary started by ryan_se at 2026-02-08T10:00:00Z.

deploy-bot: Canary canary-176850-CA entered RUNNING state. Traces enabled.

maria_cs: Great — I’ll reach out to the CatalyzeAI PM to confirm the enablement slot and surface the acceptance criteria. I’ll also capture any immediate customer concerns during the call and feed them back here.

oliver_ml: Eval results (brief): q8 candidate passed the short-chat set, longform shows 8% higher token-level edit distance but answer-stability on the 10 golden prompts is within threshold. I recommend proceeding but keep fallback sensitivity at 5% (we already have that). Full CSV uploaded to our eval bucket.

maria_cs: Perfect — thanks. I’ll draft the recommendation email + the rollback plan and send to the account. Will update thread after the enablement call.

ryan_se: If the canary stays green for 24h I’ll escalate to 30% routing and ping infra for capacity.

maria_cs: Note for renewal: this technical uplift + cost-savings projection will be part of the renewal playbook. Capture any CatalyzeAI feedback during enablement and we’ll incorporate language in the proposal.

maria_cs: (follow-up) Enablement booked Wed 2026-02-11 09:00 PT. Customer ok with the small canary. Leaving this open for final rollback hooks and post-canary notes.
